blocks.value: It's an experimental poster project created with Golden Bee Academy 2018 in Chaumont.
All posters were painted analogue with black and red color in A1 format. All original posters were exhibited in Le Signe, centre national du graphisme in Chaumont.
the posters are dedicated to Aleksandr Solzhenitsyn (1918 — 1956), his book "The Gulag Archipelago" and one of the darkest sides of Soviet system.
Poster Щ262 is about prisoners of GULAG
it is a portrait of Solzhenitsyn himself, showing how he lost his identity behind his identity number and was less important, than his  cotton wool-padded jacket, called "Vatnik".

Black and red poster were made in collaboration with Daria Tuychieva and called "I know of no other such country where a man can breathe so freely", last couplet from a patriotic soviet song "Wide is My Motherland" (1936).
